note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 2 June 1955 (round folder does not yet exist). Crumlin was the only contested division in Antrim Rural District (BT 1 Jun 1955 p6); every other division was filled unopposed or by deemed re-election, but no notice of result or full nomination list has been found in BNA. Contested. Sitting member and official Unionist Peter McMartin beat Wm. Gregg (Labour) by a majority of 65; votes not printed in the sources found (BWT prints 'Wm. Gregg', BT 'W. J. Gregg'). Uncertain: vote figures not found; only the majority (65).
